name: vram-probe-v1
purpose: 任务2：在16GB物理卡上分别预留6.5/10.5GiB，默认FLUX各跑两种尺寸；仅是卸载策略/可用预算模拟，非物理12GB/8GB验证。

cases.label: 1024 square hardware probe
cases.prompt: A matte terracotta ceramic teapot beside one cream ceramic cup on a clean oak table. Soft morning window light, a warm ivory wall, balanced product photograph, realistic clay texture, the entire objects visible with generous margins.
checks: 解码与尺寸、服务端耗时、约1秒整卡与整机内存采样
只验一次成功不声称稳定性，不把reserve当物理显存硬隔离
